name: somart
description: SoMart — Your Campus. Your Marketplace. A closed-campus peer-to-peer marketplace.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "node --watch server/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate || echo "prisma generate failed (offline?) — run npx prisma generate manually"
